data.one_liner: Simple internationalization tool based on YAML files and Dart source code generation.
data.what_it_does: Generates strongly-typed Dart classes from YAML translation files. Allows accessing messages using getters, methods with parameters, and pluralization rules.
use_when: You want compile-time checking for your localization keys.
Your localized strings require parameters or pluralization.
You prefer generating Dart classes from YAML over standard heavy i18n approaches.
avoid_when: You cannot use build_runner or source code generation in your workflow.
You need dynamic runtime loading of translations from remote servers without pre-defined classes.
strengths: Compile-time message checking and typed getters/methods.
Supports pluralization, custom language rules, and region support.
Allows dynamic access via string keys when needed.
weaknesses: Requires keeping build_runner running during development.
Custom pluralization requires manual implementation for languages other than English, Czech, and Ukrainian.
data.setup_notes: Add i69n as dependency, build_runner as dev_dependency, and run build_runner to generate classes from YAML files.
